QuestInfo.name: Greetings
QuestInfo.0: Moonbeam has something to say. You should talk to #bMoonbeam#k.
QuestInfo.1:
According to Moonbeam, Pointy-Ear Foxes aren't welcoming of outsiders. To stay in this village for a while, you should talk to Silver, the chief of the village who's also Moonbeam's grandfather.
You should talk to #bSilver#k.
QuestInfo.2: Judging by the multiple moons, this place is either very far away from the Maple World or a completely different world. Before you regain your powers, you had no option but to get help from the Pointy-Ear Foxes. So you went to talk to Silver, the chief of the village and Moonbeam's grandfather, as Moonbeam suggested.
